story_text: As a user, I want to list all my tasks so that I can see everything I need to do.

positive.title: List tasks when multiple tasks exist
steps: 1. Create multiple tasks for the authenticated user
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · all user tasks returned in response array

positive.title: List tasks when no tasks exist
steps: 1. Ensure no tasks exist for the authenticated user

positive.title: List tasks returns only the authenticated user's tasks
steps: 1. Create a task for User A
2. Create a task for User B
3. Send GET request to /tasks endpoint as User A
positive.expected_result: Response contains only User A's tasks — no data from User B

positive.title: List tasks response schema validation
steps: 1. Create a task for the authenticated user
positive.expected_result: Each task object contains id, title, status, priority, category, createdAt

negative.title: List tasks without authentication
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks endpoint without authentication token

edge.title: List tasks with large dataset (pagination check)
steps: 1. Create a large number of tasks for the authenticated user
edge.expected_result: Response is paginated or returns all within acceptable response time — no timeout or 500
